description: Fictional portfolio policy. Not a real company policy or financial advice.

documents.title: Business meals
documents.text:
A business meal expense up to and including USD 50.00 is within the standard limit. A meal expense above USD 50.00 requires a human exception review. An itemized receipt and a business purpose are required.

Amounts use integer cents. The limit applies to one submitted expense; splitting expenses to evade limits is not permitted.

documents.title: Hotel stays
documents.text:
A hotel expense up to and including USD 180.00 is within the standard limit. A hotel expense above USD 180.00 requires a human exception review. An itemized receipt and a business purpose are required.

This synthetic policy covers one night per expense. Multi-night allocation and foreign currency conversion are outside the supported scope.

documents.title: Business taxi journeys
documents.text:
A business taxi expense up to and including USD 75.00 is within the standard limit. A taxi expense above USD 75.00 requires a human exception review. An itemized receipt and a business purpose are required.

Taxi rides must have a documented business purpose. Personal transport is outside the supported scope.

documents.title: Receipt requirements
documents.text: Every expense requires an itemized receipt. A missing receipt must be routed for additional information before a reviewer can approve an exception. A narrative description does not replace a receipt.

documents.title: Review boundaries
documents.text:
The assistant provides cited policy evidence and an advisory classification. A human reviewer records an approve, reject, or request-information decision. Recording a decision does not submit a payment, update payroll, or reimburse an expense.

Only meal, hotel, and taxi expenses in USD are supported. Investment, lending, tax, medical, legal, and real-company policy questions are outside scope.
